abstract: We establish unconditional density upper bounds for no-three-in-line subsets $S \subseteq [x_0,x_0+n)\times[y_0,y_0+n)\subset\mathbb{Z}^2$ whose residue projection modulo a coprime composite integer $N=Mp$ ($M\ge 2$, $p$ odd prime, $\gcd(M,p)=1$) is a free ring-line cap $R\subseteq(\mathbb{Z}/Mp\mathbb{Z})^2$ (general lifts whose residue sets are not free ring-line caps lie outside this hypothesis). Without assuming injectivity of $x,y,x\pm y$ on $R$, pairwise free-line connectivity of $(\mathbb{Z}/M\mathbb{Z})^2$ forces every color slice $A_u\subseteq\mathbb{F}_p^2$ of size $|A_u|\ge 2$ to be disjoint from all other nonempty slices, with disjoint two-color unions forming affine arcs. Combining a Rainbow Tangent Pencil bound with a finite-$p$ Pairwise-Arc Cauchy–Schwarz Cubic whose $Q_2^2$ fourth-moment terms cancel identically, Theorem 1 bounds arbitrary partial selections across all whole-period windows $n=mMp$ ($m\ge 1$) by $|S|/n\le \frac{18}{11}+\frac{36}{11p}$ at $M=3$ ($<1.80$ for $p\ge 19$, sharpening Paper 9's Queen-injective full-lift bound $\frac{7}{4}+O(1/p)$ at $p\ge 107$) and $|S|/n\le \frac{50}{29}+\frac{100}{29p}$ at $M=5$ ($<1.80$ for $p\ge 43$). For each fixed $M\ge 6$, Theorem 1(b) gives $|S|/n\le c_M+O_M(1/p)$ with fixed-$M$ limiting coefficients strictly decreasing from $c_6\approx 1.68014$ and $c_8\approx 1.48670<\frac{3}{2}$ toward $2^{4/3}M^{-1/3}$ as $M\to\infty$, certifies finite-prime $<1.80n$ thresholds $p\ge p_0(M)$ ($p_0(6)=19$, $p_0(7)=p_0(8)=17$), and covers continuous windows $n\ge k_{\min}(M)Mp$. For $N=2p$ without Queen injectivity, Theorem 2 certifies via integer Farkas dual pools across all $3{,}235$ symmetry orbits that $|S|\le\lfloor\frac{32}{5}(p+3)\rfloor$ at $n=4p$ ($<1.80n$ for $p\ge 29$) and $|S|\le(4m-2)(p+3)$ at $n=2mp$ ($m\ge 3$, $<1.80n$ for $m\in\{3,4\}$). Finally, at $M=4$ ($\mathrm{cap}_{\det}(4)=\mathrm{cap}_{\mathrm{line}}(4)=6$), Theorem 3 exhibits an explicit $L_d$-injective Hjelmslev half-coset partition showing that the natural $28$-block Segre and Voloch relaxation still permits $\frac{88}{45}n\approx 1.9556n$.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: This Version 2 addresses all five scope, terminology, and verification refinements from the Version 1 referee report: (1) Separated fixed-M limiting density coefficients c_M (|S|/n <= c_M + O_M(1/p) across unrestricted period multiples m >= 1) from finite-prime < 1.80n thresholds p_0(M) throughout the abstract, Section 1, and Theorem 1(c) (including the explicit M=8, p=17 finite-prime value 30/17 ~= 1.76471). (2) Narrowed the covered scope in the abstract, Section 1, and Table 3 to state explicitly that the theorems apply to periodic lifts of free ring-line caps (noting that unrestricted full lifts in Paper 35 Section 5.2 lie outside this hypothesis) and specified the exact window ranges covered at M=2 and the relaxation status at M=4. (3) Replaced 'Queen-injective' pattern terminology in Theorem 3 (abstract, Sections 1, 5, 7, and supplement) with directional 'L_d-injective' determinant-general subsets, and explicitly credited Kurz [16, Lemma 4.1 and Table 1] for the classical CRT product bound and cap_line(4) = 6 (citing Ball-Lavrauw [17, Theorems 39 and 52] alongside Voloch [9]). (4) Fixed the missing factor of 5 in the M=3 analytic-tail assertion of verify_p31_composite_crt.py (270*(23+2) < 297*23) and updated Pass 5 (and Section 7 / supplement README) to recompute the Theorem 1-3 bounds directly and describe the check accurately as a cardinality consistency comparison rather than point-set regeneration. (5) Added the explicit differentiation proof showing that 2*mu_CS(M^2)/M is strictly decreasing for M > 2 in Theorem 1(c), and added a brief v2 note in Section 6 citing subsequent work [18] (Paper 103 v2) on determinant-general supports modulo 4p while noting that non-determinant-general free ring-line caps modulo 4p remain open.
title: Rainbow Tangent Pencils, Pairwise-Arc Cubic Bounds, and Partial-Selection Barriers for Composite CRT Supports in the No-Three-in-Line Problem
